purpose: Replace the probe-only HarpoonCannon visual with a direct-fire mooring-connector launcher blockout without changing placement or logic contracts.
visualContract: Direct axial launch like a classic harpoon gun; no catapult arm or ballistic throw.
The standard mooring connector is the projectile and remains visually recognizable.
The standard mooring device remains part of the assembly; the launcher does not own a duplicate cable drum.
The cable runs from the standard mooring device through a fairlead to the rear of the loaded connector.
The mooring device and cable feed stay inside the rotating assembly so 360-degree traverse does not wrap the cable around a fixed external pedestal.
The orange OBJ objects are insertion proxies only and must be replaced by the game-owned connector mesh at generation or runtime.
integrationBoundary: Do not change the current VoyageModuleActor shell, attachment probe, item replacement, placement rules, possession, input, camera, trace, HUD, or save contracts merely to adopt this model.
Treat the OBJ as a rough visual source. Preserve the current generator's component ownership and replace only its probe geometry in the narrowest safe step.
Do not package copied game-derived mesh data. Reference the installed base-game connector asset by path.
